# actionlint -ignore patterns, shared by devenv.nix (treefmt) and
# .github/workflows/actions-lint.yml (CI). One regex pattern per line.
# Blank lines and lines starting with "#" are ignored.
#
# actionlint cannot expand YAML anchors, so it treats `*checkout` /
# `*permissions` aliases in cargo.yml as opaque alias nodes and does not see
# the `rust-toolchain` step id used by later expressions.
"rust-toolchain" is not defined in object type
alias node but mapping node is expected
step must run script with "run" section or run action with "uses" section
property "artifact" is not defined in object type
